newsitem.title: FINLAND: Merita up sharply on buy recommendations.
newsitem.headline: Merita up sharply on buy recommendations.

text.p: Finnish bank group Merita extended recent gains on Wednesday as demand was sparked by positive analyst comments, brokers said.
At 1520/1220 GMT, Merita's A share traded at a new 14-month high of 13.90 markka, up 0.40 markka or almost three percent. Trading volume in the A share was a lively 40 million markka.
"Several brokerages have given buy recommendations and target prices which are clearly above the current level," one broker said, but declined to name the brokerages.
Demand was both domestic and international, brokers said.
